messages:
michelle (People Ops): Heads-up — compressed evidence window for Q2 attestation. All SOC2 + ISO owners please upload artifacts by Fri 2026-04-03. This is a hard deadline from leadership, not a soft ping. Use the Evidence Collector form: https://redwood.example/evidence-collector :loudspeaker:
compliance-bot: Automated reminder: Evidence window OPEN. Required fields: control_id, owner, short rationale. Missing owner = flagged. See guidance: https://redwood.example/compliance-guides#q2-attestation
jordan (Security): Quick Q — do we need rotation/key history logs for cloud infra controls? cc @michelle
michelle (People Ops): Yes — include key rotation logs, access review exports, change tickets, and any config snapshots. Please tag uploads with `soc2-q2` and the control ID (e.g., `CC6-1`).
alex (eng): For dedicated infra owners: any max file size or preferred archive?
sara (People Ops): Preferred: zip or tar.gz under 200MB. If >200MB, upload to org S3 and paste the pre-signed link in the form. Write a one-paragraph blurb explaining how the artifact satisfies the control.
raman (compliance): We're running two office hours next week: Tue 10:00am PT and Thu 4:00pm PT for walkthroughs + live triage. Invite will be posted in #announcements and calendar. If you can't make it, drop questions in this thread.
michelle (People Ops): Added a concise checklist in the doc: 1) Artifact uploaded 2) Owner assigned 3) Rationale filled 4) Evidence tagged 5) Attestation checkbox checked. Link: https://redwood.example/q2-checklist
alex (eng): ack — I'll assign infra owners and start batching logs. Anyone know if service desk exports need redaction first?
jordan (Security): If exports contain PII, redact or provide a sanitized export and a statement describing the redaction process. If unsure, DM me and I'll advise.
michelle (People Ops): We'll run a follow-up report on Mon to show missing owners and late uploads. Compliance-bot will ping owners 48/24/6 hours before the deadline. Please treat those pings as action items.
alex (eng): understoood :thumbsup:
raman (compliance): I'll also publish a short FAQ in the doc covering common blockers (formats, large files, transient logs).
michelle (People Ops): Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turnaround on this. If you need hands, mention @people-ops or open a triage in #help. :pray:
